name: volverjs
description: Agent skills for the Volver libraries, one plugin per package, each read from the package's own repository.

plugins.name: volverjs-style
plugins.description: Style HTML and Vue templates with the @volverjs/style design system: BEM components, utilities, tokens and the dark theme.

plugins.name: volverjs-ui-vue
plugins.description: Build Vue 3 interfaces with @volverjs/ui-vue, the component library of the Volver design system.

plugins.name: volverjs-data
plugins.description: Consume REST APIs with @volverjs/data: HttpClient, RepositoryHttp and UrlBuilder.

plugins.name: volverjs-query-vue
plugins.description: Data fetching and mutations in Vue 3 with @volverjs/query-vue store repositories.

plugins.name: volverjs-form-vue
plugins.description: Vue 3 forms built from a Zod schema with @volverjs/form-vue.

plugins.name: volverjs-zod-vue-i18n
plugins.description: Translate Zod validation errors into the active vue-i18n locale with @volverjs/zod-vue-i18n.

plugins.name: volverjs-auth-vue
plugins.description: OAuth2 / OpenID Connect authentication for Vue 3 with @volverjs/auth-vue.
